object.description: Setup: fresh install, location permission granted. Steps: 1. Open Home and read the selected activity type. 2. Select Hike, select Start, record 1 min, select Finish and save. 3. Force-stop the app, reopen it and read the selection. 4. Select Walk without starting, and read the selection. 5. Delete the Hike workout, force-stop the app, reopen it and read the selection. Expected: Step 1 shows Run, step 3 shows Hike, step 4 shows Walk and step 5 shows Run.
